newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Conn. Health and Educational.
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Conn. Health and Educational.

text.p: State of Connecticut Health and Educational
Connecticut State University System Issue, Series B Notice is hereby given that sealed bids will be received by the State of Connecticut Health and Educational
Facilities Authority at its office at 10 Columbus Boulevard, 7th Floor, Hartford, Connecticut 06106-1976 on
until 11:00 a.m. New York time for the purchase of
$39,160,000* principal amount of its Revenue Bonds,
Connecticut State University System Issue, Series B (the Bonds'').

The Bonds offered for sale will be dated as of March 15, 1997 and will mature or have sinking fund redemptions on November 1 in the years 1997 through 2017, as more fully described in the Official Notice of Sale.

The Bonds will be awarded to the bidder complying with the terms of the Official Notice of Sale and offering to purchase all of the Bonds at the lowest interest cost, calculated in accordance with the true interest cost (TIC) method. All bids must be accompanied by a certified or cashier's check or surety bond in the amount of $850,000 payable to the State of Connecticut Health and Educational Facilities Authority or naming it as the beneficiary, in the case of a surety bond.

Copies of the Preliminary Official Statement, the Official Notice of Sale and the Official Bid Form relating to the Bonds may be obtained from the Authority, 10 Columbus Avenue, 7th Floor, Hartford, Connecticut 06106 (860) 520- 4700 or Public Financial Management, Inc. at 99 Summer Street, Suite 1020, Boston, Massachusetts 02110 (617) 330- 6914.
State of Connecticut Health and Educational Facilities
*Preliminary, subject to change as described in the Official Notice of Sale.
